title: Smoothed Analysis of Inconsistent A*
abstract: arXiv:2609.23680v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The A* search is a fundamental path-finding algorithm in artificial intelligence. While admissible and consistent heuristics guarantee efficient performance by expanding each state at most once, modern search applications frequently employ powerful but inconsistent heuristics derived from machine learning, randomized evaluations, etc. A long-standing theoretical barrier to using these inconsistent heuristics is the risk of catastrophic node re-expansion, which yields a worst-case exponential time complexity of $\Omega(2^n)$. However, empirical observations contradict this pessimistic bound, demonstrating that inconsistent A* operates highly efficiently in practice.   To bridge this significant gap between theory and practice, this paper presents the first smoothed analysis of the A* algorithm using inconsistent heuristics. We model typical real-world noise by applying slight random perturbations to the edge weights of worst-case search

translated_title: 不一致A*算法的平滑分析
translated_abstract: A*搜索是人工智能中一种基础的路径查找算法。虽然可采纳且一致的启发式函数能够保证每个状态最多扩展一次，从而实现高效性能，但现代搜索应用经常使用源自机器学习、随机评估等的强大但不一致的启发式函数。使用这些不一致启发式函数的一个长期存在的理论障碍是节点灾难性重复扩展的风险，这会导致最坏情况下指数级的时间复杂度 $\Omega(2^n)$。然而，实证观察与这一悲观界限相矛盾，表明不一致的A*在实践中运行非常高效。为了弥合理论与实践之间的这一重大差距，本文首次对使用不一致启发式函数的A*算法进行了平滑分析。我们通过对最坏情况搜索的边权重施加轻微随机扰动来建模典型的现实世界噪声……
tldr: 本文首次对使用不一致启发式函数的A*算法进行平滑分析，通过对边权重施加轻微随机扰动来建模现实噪声，从理论上解释了不一致A*在实践中高效运行、与最坏情况指数级复杂度相矛盾的现象。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first smoothed analysis of A* with inconsistent heuristics, modeling real-world noise via slight random perturbations of edge weights to theoretically explain why inconsistent A* runs efficiently in practice despite the worst-case exponential time complexity.
